Checks descriptor stability and exact raw-byte SHA before strictUTF8 JSON parsing; duplicate keys and exceptional numeric constants are rejected.

Prior indices0/1 require ACTUAL_PROMOTED attestations with result/custody/review SHA256s. Current index2 requires CURRENT_COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW and explicit null custody/review fields. The parent authenticates actual review/custody contents and the linkage to numerical method bindings; this reducer does not claim to perform that external authentication.

All jobs require the same exact six-field SHA method binding plus production recipe. Frozen raw methodSHA is separate from an additional canonical method-content check; result SHA always refers to the exact raw file, never a normalized or self-referential serialization.

Validates complete source schema,128timed+1profile129updates/job, exact8frozen policy/block records and order, two positive finite warmups/six positive finite measured updates per arm, actual full-state/gradient/RNG parity and qualified nonempty native counters. Every measured sum and recorded secondary/direct ratio/log/job mean is checked against recomputation.

Recomputes primary block ratios only from selected_consumer and full_forward_io measured elapsed totals, without disabled normalization. Averages two log ratios within each job, then gives exactly three job means equal weight.

Uses sample variance divisor2, standard error sqrt(variance/3), analytic Student-t95 df2 inverse and exponentiated log interval. The analytic CDF is checked numerically only when the guarded reducer eventually runs.
Returns ratio point/interval/direction and monotone elapsed-change/time-saving percentage views of that same endpoint. The saving interval reverses the ratio bounds correctly.

Conditional point amortization divides the mean full measured profile admission cost by the equal-job mean seconds saved per update, including all negative-saving jobs. The whole profile is charged to selected_consumer alone. The point is absent without positive pooled savings, and no cost-win is supported by an inconclusive primary interval.

No data files are modified or written; the future driver must first persist raw timing-study.json and separate analysis-input-bindings.json, then call the reducer and persist timing-pooled-analysis.json. Any invalid input fails the entire reduction; there is no subset, replacement or complete-case interval.

potential_risks_or_caveats: Parent-authenticated attestations are a required trust boundary; the reducer does not inspect or cryptographically sign review/custody control contents.
Exactly3independentjobs anddf2 require strong normality/independence assumptions. The interval is not a simultaneous family guarantee or a model/history population claim.
Python binary64 arithmetic is finite; overflow, underflow tozero or nonfinite fields fail closed. Recorded/recomputed quantities use relative andabsolute tolerance1e-12.
Point amortization is conditional and is not a confidence bound. An inconclusive primaryCI grants no cost-win.
